name: Safari Event Tracking Dropped on Checkout
description: A JavaScript tracking script update deployed on 2026-09-18 introduced an issue where 'order_completed' analytics events are dropped on Safari browsers (~90% missing in event stream), even though the actual backend orders and revenue succeed normally.
ground_truth_cause: Analytics client-side SDK telemetry dropped tracking events on Safari (ITP/cookie or script syntax bug). Actual backend orders succeeded, causing a discrepancy between analytics events and financial orders.

expected_observable_effects.events: order_completed events on Safari drop by ~90% after Sept 18
expected_observable_effects.orders: Real backend orders remain normal on Safari, creating a divergence between events and orders tables
expected_observable_effects.daily_product_metrics: Total tracked events drop slightly on Safari funnel; financial revenue unaffected
expected_observable_effects.future_investigation_hook: Investigator comparing orders table vs events tracking will detect that backend payment logs are intact while telemetry events dropped, pinpointing an instrumentation/analytics bug.
